description: Stable release of the five-platform fork with task-based execution ownership and proportionate checks
changelog:
**Enhancements:**
- Workflow guidance now lets one executor complete a bounded task end to end; independent review is selected for public-interface, cross-module, important-risk, or explicitly required work.
- Checks can be reused for unchanged code and premises, while affected checks run again after a change.
- Current templates and prompts keep Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Pi, and dsh aligned with these rules.
notes: Run moksha-trellis update to refresh managed workflow guidance and prompts. No --migrate step is required; locally modified files remain subject to the normal update conflict flow.
